rules.title: Prisma Client Bytes fields return Uint8Array instead of Node.js Buffer in Prisma 6
rules.description: In Prisma 6, model fields of type Bytes return native JavaScript Uint8Array objects instead of Node.js Buffer. Code relying on Buffer-specific methods (like .readInt32BE() or .toString('hex')) must be wrapped in Buffer.from() or migrated to Uint8Array APIs.

remediation.summary: Wrap Bytes field results in Buffer.from(bytes) if Buffer-specific methods are needed, or use Uint8Array methods.

rules.title: NotFoundError export has been removed from @prisma/client in Prisma 6
rules.description: The legacy NotFoundError class export has been removed from @prisma/client in Prisma 6. Check for PrismaClientKnownRequestError with error code 'P2025' instead.

remediation.summary: Replace NotFoundError with Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError checking for error code 'P2025'.
remediation.exampleAfter:
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
// Check (err instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && err.code === 'P2025')

rules.title: rejectOnNotFound query option has been removed in Prisma 6
rules.description: The rejectOnNotFound option in findUnique and findFirst queries has been removed. Use findUniqueOrThrow() and findFirstOrThrow() methods instead.

remediation.summary: Remove rejectOnNotFound and call findUniqueOrThrow() or findFirstOrThrow().
remediation.exampleBefore: await prisma.post.findUnique({ where: { id }, rejectOnNotFound: true });

rules.title: prisma.$use() middleware pattern is deprecated in Prisma 6; migrate to $extends
rules.description: The traditional prisma.$use() middleware pattern is deprecated in Prisma 6 and scheduled for complete removal in Prisma 7. Migrate all middleware logic to Prisma Client Extensions ($extends).

remediation.summary: Migrate prisma.$use middleware hooks to Client Extensions with prisma.$extends({ query: { ... } }).

rules.title: Usage of $executeRawUnsafe or $queryRawUnsafe without tagged parameters
rules.description: Direct string interpolation in $executeRawUnsafe and $queryRawUnsafe is hazardous. Use the parameterized tagged template literals $executeRaw or $queryRaw.

remediation.summary: Replace $executeRawUnsafe with tagged template literal $executeRaw`...` to ensure SQL inputs are escaped.
remediation.exampleBefore: await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(`DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ${id}`);
remediation.exampleAfter: await prisma.$executeRaw`DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ${id}`;
